en:
He seemed like he'd try to fight an Exisal
by himself if we left him alone...
<CLT=cltMIND>Should I hang out with Tsumugi for a while?

I wonder why Gonta's so worried 
about being useful to everyone.

Now that I think about it, I'm way less 
useful than he is...

Oh... I shouldn't have said that out loud...
Now I'm depressed...
<CLT=cltMIND>I spent some time cheering up Tsumugi...
<CLT=cltMIND>Tsumugi and I grew a little closer today.
